name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 8 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-05-14, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
